title: "Games are art."
text: A well-crafted story in a game hits harder than any movie or book. The interactivity makes you *part* of the narrative, not just a spectator.

title: "Completionism is a lifestyle."
text: If there's a side quest, I'm doing it. If there's a hidden cave, I'm exploring it. 100% or bust. Every achievement, every collectible, every secret ending.

title: "Difficulty = Respect."
text: I play on the hardest difficulty first. Elden Ring, Sekiro, Baldur's Gate on Honour Mode — the struggle is what makes victory meaningful.
